mass_prior.actual_definition: M_z = sum_d F_raw[z,d], over the full source OD file before tile filtering; missing or zero replaced by 1e-6
mass_prior.interpretation: Observed movement mass for each zone; not an independent resident population measurement. M_j is j's outflow, not j's incoming flow.
mass_prior.availability: Explicit aggregate prior for every zone, including validation and heldout. Pair-level heldout scores remain unavailable during discovery.

od_composition.backbone: concat(log(M_i), G_i[18], log(M_j), G_j[18], distance_ij_km) = 39 dimensions
od_composition.origin_role: Potential source scale and departure context, interacting with destination choice
od_composition.destination_role: Potential attraction, capacity and access context
od_composition.directionality: The same zone can have different source and destination roles; roles may coexist and change with the paired zone and distance. Reversing i,j generally changes the mechanism.
mass_combinations: destination facility count / regularized destination movement mass
origin movement mass interacting with destination facilities and distance
distance-weighted opportunities relative to neighboring movement mass
od_composition.measurement_limits: Mass-normalized counts are per movement mass, not per resident. An origin-only additive score cancels in row softmax; use destination or interacting pair terms. A raw mass product followed by log may separate into origin+destination, so examine its actual within-row variation.

normalization_audit.readme: All location features except distance described as divided by zone area
normalization_audit.public_new_york_runtime: oa2features.pkl equals the first component of each of the 18 stored categories on all 5367 shared zones. No area division occurs in the loader. main.py prepends natural log of oa2pop.
normalization_audit.current_policy: Preserve supplied numerical values. Do not assert physical units for their tiny stored area/length values. Recompute metric densities from historical OSM when needed.
normalization_audit.discarded_placeholders: The second list component of five polygon categories is constant zero and absent from the actual 18-dimensional upstream vector.

open_extensions: Use all observed OSM tags and executable spatial relations. The seven supplied groups are baseline recipes, not limits on attractors or zone identities.
